question: Does the unchanged dual-surface reference-conditioned proposal mechanism confirm on three physically target-disjoint 3RScan doors selected before RGB and model access?

predecessor.single_change: Replace consumed DR01-DR03 with the pre-RGB, model-blind, physical-target-disjoint confirmation cohort. Keep native reference support masks, bound-bbox extent, RoMa/SAM2 models, all thresholds, component selection, affine transport, query mask postprocess and decision gate identical.

source.target_scope: New physical target instances 36, 37 and 28 were selected from 92 candidates after excluding all physical targets in five consumed 3RScan cohorts. Selection opened 8933 pose and depth members, zero RGB members, and zero models. The cohort shares two reference scans with prior Development but includes two new rescan IDs.

reference_binding.support_surface: Unchanged one native SAM2 mask prompted by the provider-projected reference bbox; used for cycle-component selection and bilateral scoring.
reference_binding.extent_surface: Unchanged provider-projected reference bbox rectangle; only its four corners are transported through the support-surface affine map.
reference_binding.query_truth_isolation: Query provider bbox remains unavailable until the prompt is frozen and is used only for IoU evaluation.

proposal.transport: Unchanged symmetric full-frame RoMa; certainty >=0.05 both ways; in-bounds target; round-trip error <=0.013888888888888888; largest 8-connected support component; ordinary least-squares affine map; project the bound extent corners into one clipped query box.
proposal.component_tie_break: Unchanged maximum component pixel area, then lowest label; no minimum area, truth access or fallback.
proposal.mask: Unchanged one native reference SAM2 mask and one native query SAM2 mask, multimask_output=false, mask_threshold=0.0, no score selection, morphology, expansion or retry.

matcher.absolute_support: Unchanged bilateral one-percent native-mask cycle fraction and majority cycle purity.

evaluation.query_target_bbox: Opened only after prompt generation for IoU evaluation.
evaluation.no_cross_pair_assignment_claim: Target-conditioned true-pair component confirmation only; no closed-roster NONE assignment claim.

forbidden_after_freeze: change support or extent surfaces, models, RoMa thresholds, component, affine fit, SAM postprocess, frames, targets or decision gate
use query truth, labels, transforms or target identity to generate or select a prompt
retry or replace any frame, prompt, mask or component after outcome
call same-provider physical-target-disjoint confirmation provider-independent or raw-phone evidence
call the result initial discovery, open-world absence authority, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, arrival, handoff, Android, benefit, reliability or safety evidence
claim_boundary: A pass is pre-RGB, model-blind, physical-target-disjoint same-provider Development confirmation that the unchanged dual-surface mechanism transfers to three new doorframe targets. It still uses privileged initial reference bboxes and 3RScan geometry, shares two reference scans with earlier Development, covers only three targets and two scan families, and runs on desktop GPU. It is not raw-camera initial binding, provider-independent generalization, open-world absence authority, named entrance, ownership, public access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, Android deployment, user benefit, reliability or safety.
